Name: Messy Crops
Author: tlitookilakin
TagLine: No more boring, tidy rows of crops! Adds a random offset to each crop to give your fields a wilder look. Can be disabled for trellis crops.
Description:
![About](http://wrengrasley.com/hosted/stardew/general/about.png)
Messy Crops is a simple mod which slightly randomizes crop positions to give your plants a more organic look. It is a purely cosmetic mod, which does not effect the functionality or collision of crops. It applies to all crops, including ones in garden pots, but can be configured.
![Configuration](http://wrengrasley.com/hosted/stardew/general/configuration.png)
This mod can be configured in-game using [GMCM](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/771692-generic-mod-config-menu). (Though only on the title screen, for performance reasons.)

Messy Crops currently offers the following config options:
* **Offset:** Controls how much crops are moved by. Can be set to 0 to disable the mod entirely.
* **Apply to Trellis:** Whether or not trellis crops should also be offset. (For those who like their trellis crops in nice neat rows.)

![Installation](http://wrengrasley.com/hosted/stardew/general/installation.png)
﻿Just download the zip and extract it into your Mods folder. Make sure SMAPI is installed and up-to-date.
![More Info](http://wrengrasley.com/hosted/stardew/general/more-info.png)
